scope: Agent-authored task narratives frozen before any matcher execution on this fixture. Diagnostic cases may inform changes; sentinel labels and queries must remain unchanged. This is software evaluation, not independent user research, an untouched training holdout, domain-expert review or professional suitability validation. All text is synthetic and public.

roles.query: A community theatre needs an accessible browser booking form, responsive CSS and JavaScript validation. I want to build the interface people use.
I want to deliver a complete web application, connecting its browser UI, API, persistent data and deployment rather than one layer alone.
My interest is an Android and iOS app that survives a lost connection, device rotation and conflicting offline edits.
I enjoy querying datasets with SQL, cleaning records in Python and explaining business patterns through charts, rather than shipping predictive models.
I would like to define business intelligence measures and build Power BI dashboards whose revenue totals stay consistent across departments.
I want to build and deploy machine learning models, compare slice performance, version artifacts and monitor their production behavior.
I like responding to hosted-service tickets, diagnosing cloud outages and explaining mitigations clearly to customers.
I want to work on a help desk, troubleshooting employee desktops, accounts, printers and everyday connectivity problems.
I like DevOps work: Docker images, CI/CD release pipelines, infrastructure automation and reversible deployments.
I enjoy creating CAD manufacturing drawings with datums, dimensions, revision notes and tolerance-stack reasoning.
I want to investigate production quality defects using measurement-system checks, containment, root cause and corrective-action verification.
I like diagnosing low-voltage electronics: circuit diagrams, resistor measurements, voltage, current and instrument loading.
I want to own product prioritization: choose user problems, compare opportunities and decide experiments using outcome measures and guardrails.
My interest is user interface design: typography, spacing, responsive components, clear error states and accessible visual hierarchy.
I want digital product design from research through interaction and visual prototypes, balancing user needs with product trade-offs.
I like coordinating projects by maintaining dependency logs, milestone trackers, meeting actions and concise stakeholder updates.
I want operations analysis: quantify service queues, capacity constraints and handoff delays using reliable operational measures.
I like management consulting, comparing organizational operating models and making evidence-based recommendations to leadership.
I want digital marketing campaign work: audience targeting, channel experiments, landing pages and qualified lead measurement.
I enjoy content writing and editing: audience-focused articles, credible claims, useful structure and an editorial brief.
I want graphic design work on visual identities, typography, image composition and print or digital campaign layouts.
I enjoy bookkeeping and accounting: record accruals, reconcile cashbook entries and prepare a reliable month-end balance.
I want payroll work: reconcile approved timesheets, calculate stated gross-to-net pay and control authorized pay corrections.
I want audit work linking assertions to sufficient evidence, documenting control exceptions and maintaining traceable workpapers.
I enjoy recruitment: write job-related selection criteria, coordinate structured interviews and compare candidate work samples consistently.
I want to coordinate workplace learning programmes, align training objectives with practice and measure transfer back to job tasks.
I want talent development work designing progression and coaching opportunities with transparent skills criteria and follow-up evidence.
I enjoy sales discovery calls, qualifying a business buyer's needs and agreeing a realistic proposal and next step.
I want customer support work: reproduce a user's immediate problem, explain a workaround and hand off unresolved cases clearly.
I enjoy logistics coordination: stock movements, warehouse dispatch, shipment exceptions, inventory records and clear handovers.
